About

Eucerin® Sun Face Oil Control Daily UV Serum SPF 50+ combines very high UVB/UVA protection, blue light and pollution defence in an ultra-light, mattifying formula.
NART: 99554-09900-00

OUR FIRST UV SERUM WITH THE LIGHTEST OIL CONTROL FORMULA

Our lightest and most advanced Oil Control UV-protection with clinically proven triple action formula:

1. AOX Shield Technology with Licochalcone A:

- Provides very high UVB/UVA protection

- Strengthens cellular defence against oxidative stress from UV + blue light

- Prevents sun-induced premature skin ageing

Additionally, Glycyrrhetinic Acid to support the skin's own DNA repair mechanism. 

2. Oil Control Technology with sebum-regulating L-Carnitine and lipid-absorbing microparticles for long-lasting mattifying effect.

3. Anti-pollution Vitamin Booster powered by Vitamins C, E and Pro-vitamin B5 to defend against free radicals induced by environmental aggressors such as pollution.

How to Use

Use Eucerin Sun Face Oil Control Daily UV Serum SPF 50+ as the last step in your morning skincare routine. 1: Cleanse 2: Treat / Moisturise 3: UV-Serum

Step-by-step guide for Sun Face Oil Control Daily UV Serum SPF 50+

SHAKE

Shake well before use.

APPLY

Apply to a clean, dry face, neck and décolleté. Gently massage until fully absorbed and avoid contact with the eyes.

REAPPLY

Reapply frequently, especially after swimming, perspiring or toweling to maintain the original protection.

Clinical Formula

Vitamin C

Vitamin C is a skin's own ingredient and acts as a vital antioxidant and is an essential cofactor in collagen synthesis. Two key benefits are:

  • Neutralises Free Radicals: Protects against oxidative stress caused by external stressors such as UV radiation and pollution, preventing premature ageing.
  • Collagen Synthesis Support: stimulates collagen synthesis to supports skin firmness and elasticity, maintaining a youthful and radiant appearance.
Learn More
Pro Vitamin B5

Provitamin B5, also known as Panthenol, is a precursor to vitamin B5. Panthenol participates in numerous metabolic processes (e.g., energy production, synthesis of fatty acids) and helps improve hydration in the outermost layers of the skin. It helps maintain moisture, supports skin barrier regeneration, and prevents dryness and irritation. When applied regularly, it has been proven to significantly improve symptoms of skin irritation such as dryness, roughness, scaling, and redness. It also provides benefits in improving skin firmness.

Well absorbed by the skin, it supports regeneration, stimulates epithelialisation and wound healing, and alleviates irritation and inflammation.

Learn More
Vitamin E

Vitamin E (Tocopherol) is a natural essential component of the skin and acts as a major lipophilic antioxidant, helping to protect your cells from damage caused by solar radiation, pollution, and other environmental stressors. It works by neutralising free radicals that can contribute to premature skin ageing. As natural Vitamin E levels decrease with age and are depleted by UV exposure, this ingredient helps reinforce the skin’s own defence system.

Learn More
Licochalcone A

Licochalcone A is a powerful antioxidant, anti-inflammatory and skin-soothing ingredient. It is derived from the root of the Chinese Licorice plant (Glycyrrhiza Inflata) which uses natural compounds to protect its cells from excessive sunlight. When used in skincare products, Licochalcone A works to reduce inflammation and neutralise free radicals that negatively influence skin cells and accelerate the ageing process. It helps to protect the deeper epidermal skin layers from sun-induced effects.

Learn More
Glycyrrhetinic Acid

Glycyrrhetinic Acid is derived from the roots of the Chinese Licorice plant − Glycyrrhiza Glabra − and is known for its antioxidant and skin-soothing properties. It helps to protect the skin cells in the deeper epidermal layers from harmful UV-induced free radicals and supports skin´s own DNA repair mechanism.

Learn More
Carnitine

L-Carnitine (also known as Carnitine) is an amino-acid derivative found in the skin and is produced from the amino acids lysine and methionine. Localized application of Carnitine on the skin helps to significantly reduce the amount of sebum.

FAQ

How do I know which SPF to use?

Sunscreens are available in four different levels of protection: low (factor 6 to 10), medium (15 to 25), high (30 to 50) and very high (50+). The higher the protection factor the better your skin is protected, but it’s important to apply the product thoroughly (be careful not to miss any bits) and to reapply it generously every two hours.

Can sunscreen clog my pores and lead to breakouts?

Some people with oily and acne-prone skin are concerned that sunscreen will worsen their symptoms and avoid sun protection altogether. Specially formulated products such as Eucerin Sun Face Oil Control Daily UV Serum SPF 50+ are designed to manage oily and even improve acne-prone skin conditions. 

Why do I need to integrate sun face care into my daily routine?

Facial skin is more sensitive to UVA/UVB radiation and HEVIS light than skin on the rest of the body as it is exposed to sun all year round. Sun protection can help you avoid the cellular DNA damage caused by UV, photoageing (premature ageing caused by the sun) and hyperpigmentation. It is important to protect facial skin whenever it is exposed to the sun.

Where does Eucerin Sun Face Oil Control Daily Serum SPF 50+ fit in my skincare routine?

Eucerin Sun Face Oil Control Daily Serum SPF 50+ should be applied in the morning as the last step of your skincare routine.  Its lightweight texture absorbs quickly and has an invisible finish. It's ideal as a make-up base.

Can I use a sunscreen serum instead of a regular sunscreen?

A sunscreen serum like Eucerin Sun Face Oil Control Daily UV-Serum SPF 50+ provides the same high protection (SPF 50+) against UVA/UVB rays and blue light as a traditional sunscreen while offering a lighter, fast-absorbing texture. It’s specifically developed for oily or acne-prone skin and gives a matte finish without clogging pores. You can use it as your main sun protection step in the morning.
